senses.gloss: ? bhaḍḍalikā, perh. n. of some animal: Pischel, SBBA 1904 〔p. 817, fol. 169 b〕; Pischel 〔p. 824〕 suggests dubiously connexion with (ambaka)maddarī of the corresp. Pali passage AN 〔i.188.2〕. He is probably right, but unfortunately this doesnʼt help much; the Pali word is very obscure; acc. to the comm. 〔ii.304.14〕 the cpd. means a young hen (khuddaka-kukkuṭikā).
